title: Triadic Capital Monica Schell：中期选举后，AI债务扩张会放缓吗？
speaker: Monica Schell

segments.en: How do you look at post midterms right? Yeah, the dams taking back congress There seems to be this narrative that they're going to oppose
segments.zh: 中期选举后你怎么看？民主党夺回国会，有种说法是他们将反对

segments.en: The build out of data centers and the light does that in some way slow down The amount of financing the AI sort of debt boom that we saw in the credit markets
segments.zh: 数据中心建设，这会不会在某种程度上放缓AI融资和信贷市场的债务热潮？

segments.en: Well, you know, it's interesting because even as that happened post midterms immediately we see jumbo issuances right including meta and so forth so um I think that um the
segments.zh: 有意思的是，中期选举后立即出现大规模发行，包括Meta等，所以我认为

segments.en: Credit you're still going to see more supply in that space that's not going to stop the pace may slow down a bit But overall I would say that um there's a natural caution anyway when rates go up and your cost of funding goes up
segments.zh: 信贷领域供应仍会增加，不会停止，步伐可能稍缓。但总体而言，利率上升、融资成本增加时，自然会有谨慎情绪

segments.en: You know, there should naturally be more restrictive liquidity there and you have the just a lot of competition for demand
segments.zh: 流动性自然会更具限制性，而且需求方面竞争激烈

segments.en: So this was the case even before the midterms now post the midterms You know first of all I do think there was a bit initially an overreaction
segments.zh: 这在中期选举前就是如此，选举后，首先我认为最初有点过度反应

segments.en: Which is why equity markets came back a bit But it's still the going to be a matter of first we're going to everybody's going to be watching how and thropic IPO goes
segments.zh: 所以权益市场有所回升，但仍要看Anthropic的IPO进展

segments.en: You know, I don't know if you noticed but yesterday there was a bit of a mix-up of headline at first and thropic was coming out saying it was like Going to be you know go end
segments.zh: 不知你注意到没，昨天头条有点混乱，最初说Anthropic要上市

segments.en: And then now it's back to something more normal of like a valuation of 1.4 billion And that gave people a little bit of a sigh of relief as to what they're still able to gun for
segments.zh: 现在恢复到更正常的估值14亿，这让人们松了一口气，觉得仍可争取

segments.en: And I think everybody's just you know going to watch to see how the stock performs So I you know in terms of what the Dems really can do at the end of the day you're looking at a gridlock
segments.zh: 大家都会关注权益资产表现。民主党真正能做的，最终是僵局

segments.en: Government and the existing data operations are still going to be going There is a moratorium and it is going to be decided at the state level
segments.zh: 政府和现有数据业务仍将继续推进，目前处于暂停期，将由州层面决定。
